summary: Defines an option in IPv6 Router Advertisement messages that expands the number of flag bits available. The original 8-bit flags field in Neighbor Discovery was close to being used up by various protocols. This option adds room for more flags. It is a standards-track specification and replaces RFC 5075.

eli5.summary: A form has only eight little checkboxes and they are almost all used. This adds a second sheet with many more checkboxes.
